posts.title: Context engineering for designers: one-shotting design for fun and profit
posts.description: Getting your one-shots to not suck, one very painful step at a time.

posts.title: The last product design tool
posts.description: Once you have an established design system in code, the interface already inherits a set of visual rules. This creates a world in which an AI coding tool can read a sketch and build out a passable interface from it using those rules.

posts.title: The role of canvas in the AI-assisted design process
posts.description: The longer I work with agentic AI code generation, the more I realize that the canvas/whiteboard based approach is still needed, except for designers, it’s no longer going to be the only medium they touch. The role of the canvas changed with the new processes and tools:
